description: Screen a vendor's ultimate beneficial owners in four independent stages: first compute 25% UBO ownership from caller-supplied ownership structure under the FinCEN Customer Due Diligence rule (ART-268, bank KYB, not CTA/BOI beneficial ownership reporting and not the OFAC 50% rule); then screen caller-supplied persons against a caller-supplied private test list, never live sanctions data (ART-413, the screened list stays private); then assemble the screening evidence pack from caller-supplied run facts (ART-585); then a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). All ownership, screening, and evidence facts are caller-supplied; findings are arithmetic findings, never compliance determinations. Federal only, not legal advice.
name: vendor-onboarding-ubo-screening-check

steps.handoff: Computes 25% ultimate beneficial owners from caller-supplied ownership structure under the FinCEN Customer Due Diligence rule (bank KYB; not CTA/BOI reporting, not the OFAC 50% rule)
Screens caller-supplied persons against a caller-supplied private test list (never live sanctions data; the screened list stays private)
Assembles the sanctions screening evidence pack from caller-supplied run facts
Produces session_receipt_root, the Merkle root over the run's execution_hashes (final stage)

title: Vendor Onboarding UBO Screening Check
